summary: Reads one 16-bit word from a buffer described by a pointer-array descriptor (a1). Consults a flag/status byte at a1[3]: fails fast on reserved bits, forces the in-progress bit on retry, rewinds to the base buffer (a1[2]) when a continue bit is set or allocates through MemoryAllocatorInit otherwise, fills the buffer via sub_58C9B4, validates the returned size, conditionally widens the requested read size from 512 to 4096, and returns the next word while advancing the read pointer. Structural twin of sub_58C255 per cluster prelabel.

local_names.a1: buffer descriptor as pointer array: [0]=read ptr, [1]=result size, [2]=base ptr, [3]=flag byte, [4]=index/id, [6]=read size
local_names.v4: row/source descriptor base for flag validation

operations.description: if ((flag & 0x83) == 0 || (flag & 0x40) != 0) return 0xFFFF — reserved/aborted flag bits cause immediate failure
if (flag & 2) != 0: flag |= 0x20; return 0xFFFF — a pending retry is marked in-progress and the call aborts
if (flag & 0x10C) != 0: a1[0] := a1[2] (rewind read pointer to base buffer); else call MemoryAllocatorInit(a1)
v2 := sub_58C9B4((int)a1[4], a1[2], (DWORD)a1[6]) — fetch data for index a1[4] into the base buffer
a1[1] := v2 — record the returned size
if (v2 < 2 || v2 == -1): flag |= (v2 != 0 ? 32 : 16); a1[1] := 0; return 0xFFFF — undersized/failed read sets an error bit and clears the size

if (flag & 0x82) == 0: v4 := (a1[4] == -1) ? &unk_5E7898 : dword_8D4920[a1[4] >> 5] + 36 * (a1[4] & 0x1F); if (v4[4] & 0x82) == 0x82 then set the high-byte flag bit (0x20) — validate the source descriptor state
if (a1[6] == 512): if (flag & 8) != 0 && (flag high byte & 4) == 0: a1[6] := 4096 — widen the read size when a size-boost bit is set and not already widened
a1[1] := v2 - 2 — store the usable content size (result minus two)
result := *(unsigned __int16*)a1[0] (word at obj + 0); a1[0] := a1[0] + 1; return result — fetch and consume the next 16-bit word
